messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-87234 - HIGH - spike of 429s from rate-limiter (service: api.redwood.com) in region us-west-2. Auto-page to oncall. Symptoms: sudden jump in client 429 errors, request success degraded. Links: https://pagerduty.example/PD-87234 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-87234 created (service: rate-limiter). Acknowledgement required. Escalation plan: primary oncall -> Sam H, then Theo - Ops Lead.

Sam H: acked. I'm online, taking lead. Starting initial triage.

Devon (oncall): seeing 18% 429s at the edge for us-west-2, global ~4.8%. Logs show quota_check failing with fallback default quota. Possible quota-mapper misapply.

Maria C: tagging product/sales: can we get a quick list of top impacted tenants? customers seeing elevated 429s?

Devon (oncall): querying logs now. top affected tenants by 429 count: [acme-corp, pilotpay, skylift, thirdbridge, buildflow]. Sending aggregates.

Devon (oncall): pastebin of recent quota-check lines:
```
[2026-03-10T22:01:12Z] quota-mapper: tenant_id=null matched_rule=default_quota applied_quota=1000
[2026-03-10T22:01:12Z] quota-check: tenant=acme-corp expected_quota=100000 applied_quota=1000
[2026-03-10T22:01:13Z] limiter: issuing 429 for tenant=acme-corp token_bucket=exhausted
```

Alisha R: summary for execs: some paying customers getting throttled unexpectedly. We should reduce impact quickly, then follow up.

Theo - Ops Lead: if quota-mapper returned null tenant mapping, looks like config push to quota-mapper earlier today may have introduced a rule precedence bug. Immediate mitigation options: 1) flip enforcement to soft-mode, 2) revert quota-mapper config, 3) route traffic to fallback limiter pool. Pick one and I will coordinate.

Sam H: doing 1) soft-mode toggle first to reduce customer impact. How to toggle: admin flag via control-plane.

devex-bot: quick toggle command (control plane API):
```
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"flag":"quota_enforcement","value":"soft"}'
```

Sam H: issuing toggle now.

Sam H: done. console shows flag quorum accepted. Switching enforcement -> soft.

pagerduty-bot: PD-87234 acknowledged by Sam H at 2026-03-10T22:05:08Z. Escalation paused.

Devon (oncall): monitoring metrics after toggle. us-west-2 429 rate falling from 18% -> 3.2% in last 90s. Good sign.

Maria C: can we confirm which tenants still masked? any long-tail? Also we need to notify customers via status page.

Sam H: running query for 429s by tenant now. preliminary: acme-corp 429 rate down to 1.4%, pilotpay down to 0.9%.

Alisha R: I'm drafting status page update, will post once we confirm stability.

Theo - Ops Lead: we should still revert the config that caused this. Who pushed the quota-mapper change? Devon, can you check gitops history?

Devon (oncall): found recent config commit: repo ops/quota-mapper, commit 9b3f7e pushed 2026-03-10T21:58Z by deploy-bot. It changed rule precedence for tenant fallback. Looks like fallback rule moved above explicit tenant match.

Sam H: ok. plan: (a) keep soft-mode on, (b) revert quota-mapper commit to pre-9b3f7e, (c) deploy test, (d) monitor for regression, then re-enable strict enforcement. Anyone object?

Theo - Ops Lead: +1. If revert is quick, do it. I'll coordinate a canary to us-west-2 only first.

Devon (oncall): starting revert PR now. Will create a hotfix branch and request an expedited deploy.

devex-bot: hotfix PR created: ops/quota-mapper#542 revert precedence change. CI: running.

Sam H: while CI runs, keeping soft-mode in place. Any customer blocking actions we need?

Maria C: Sales wants a lift for acme-corp ASAP. I'll DM their CSM with the update and ETA.

Devon (oncall): CI green, approving and merging hotfix. Deploying to canary (us-west-2) now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/quota-mapper -n redwood-canary`.

Sam H: monitoring canary. Logs show mapping restored for acme-corp. 429s trending to baseline.

pagerduty-bot: PD-87234 - escalation: Theo - Ops Lead notified for post-merge verification.

Theo - Ops Lead: after canary stable for 5 minutes, schedule full rollout.

Devon (oncall): canary stable. Rolling out to prod now with 10% progressive steps.

Sam H: prod rollout step 1/10 complete. Watching metrics.

Sam H: prod rollout 10/10 complete. All regions show 429 rates back to normal baselines (<0.5% global).

Maria C: posting status update: "Resolved: Partial quota enforcement misconfiguration caused temporary throttling; mitigation performed (soft-mode) and revert deployed. Impact: short-lived 429 spike affecting a handful of tenants; customers contacted." Will attach incident number and next steps.

Alisha R: posted to status.redwood.com and emailed CSMs for top 5 affected customers.

Devon (oncall): leaving soft-mode on for 30 minutes as buffer, then we'll flip enforcement back to strict after verification.

Sam H: creating incident ticket for postmortem and assigning owners. TL;DR: config precedence regression in quota-mapper; root cause: deploy-bot autopatch changed rule ordering without test that included tenant precedence.

incident-bot: Incident PD-87234 status updated: RESOLVED - Acknowledged at 2026-03-10T22:05:08Z, Resolved at 2026-03-10T22:14:30Z. Postmortem assigned.

Theo - Ops Lead: postmortem owners: Maria C (customer comms), Devon (root cause + fix), Sam H (mitigation + timeline). Please capture timeline, RCA, and follow-up actions: add unit test for rule precedence, gate autopatch, add synthetic that verifies tenant-specific quotas.

Sam H: noted. I'll open the postmortem doc and assign.

Maria C: thanks team. I'll schedule a follow-up with affected customers tomorrow.

Alisha R: closing loop with sales. Great quick work everyone. :clap:
